title: Credit Memo Calculation: Package Allowance Returned on a Removed Design Studio Selections Line
content:
**Calculation.** The line concerned is the most recently removed option line on the Design Studio Selections file. The allowance return is the return measure times the return percent, rounded half up to the cent; the return percent is the return share plus the homesite points plus the delay points, never above 100. The return measure is all package allowance applied to the removed line, and the return share is 100 percent with no homesite points and no delay points.

**Inputs**

- *Removed line* — the latest removal entry on the design ledger, with the line number it carries.
- *Package allowance applied to it* — the package allowance credit applications on the design ledger that carry that line number, added together.

**Order of working.** The return share and any points are added into one return percent, which stops at 100; the return measure is multiplied by that percent; the product is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figure (hypothetical)**

| Package allowance applied to the removed line | Return percent | Allowance return |
|---|---|---|
| 1234.56 | 100 percent | 1234.56 |
